en: A black‑and‑white street scene in a small town, showing an unpaved road lined with trees and a few pedestrians in the distance. On the right stands a two‑story functionalist building with the large sign "SVENSKA HANDELSBANKEN" on the facade, indicating a bank branch. Further down the street are additional modest multi‑story buildings and detached houses surrounded by trees, under a clear sky.
